heading_font.name: Fraunces
heading_font.usage: Use for all H1-H3 headings. Editorial, warm, authoritative yet organic.

body_font.name: Nunito
body_font.usage: Use for body text, UI elements, and labels. Clean, rounded, friendly.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1] text-primary-900

layout.spacing: Relaxed. Use p-8, py-20, py-32 for sections. Don't crowd content.
layout.grid_strategy: Use Bento grids for 'Who It's For'. Avoid symmetrical 3-column layouts where possible.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain/noise on solid backgrounds to avoid 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders with low opacity (#0A4849 with 10% opacity) for cards.

hero.layout: Full screen height (min-h-screen). Video background with dark overlay (bg-primary/80).
hero.content: Headline: 'Real Food. Honest Ingredients. No Shortcuts.' Subhead: 'Kochi's first 100% preservative-free meal subscription.'
hero.actions: Primary CTA: 'View Open Roles' (anchor to hiring), Secondary: 'Join Waitlist'.
hero.visuals: Marquee at bottom: 'Launching Soon • Kochi • Preservative Free • Fresh Daily'

manifesto.layout: Large typography, scroll-triggered opacity reveal. Sticky container.
manifesto.content: Focus on the 'Why': No chemicals, no frozen bases, just fresh food cooked daily.

audience.layout: Asymmetric grid. Cards for: 'Busy Professionals', 'Health Enthusiasts', 'Travelers'.
audience.style: Clean white cards on soft green background. Icons + short text.

how_it_works.layout: Left side content, right side sticky image/visual.

hiring.layout: Clean list layout. Emphasis on 'Grow With Us'.
hiring.style: Minimalist. High contrast headers. 'Apply Now' buttons link to Google Form.
hiring.visual: Use a solid color block or abstract shape if team photos are unavailable.

footer.content: Newsletter signup, Social links, Quick links.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Icons: Leaf, Truck, ChefHat, Clock, Heart, Users, ArrowRight.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_handling: Use the ./client directory for all frontend work. Files are .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Single page application. Use 'react-scroll' for section navigation if needed, or simple IDs.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Extend tailwind.config.ts with the brand colors. Use 'class-variance-authority' (cva) for component variants.
instructions_to_main_agent.interactions: Ensure hover states are visible (change opacity or subtle scale). Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs.
instructions_to_main_agent.seo: Add proper meta tags for 'Zipplit - Preservative Free Food Delivery Kochi'.

universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients on text unless crucial for emphasis.
Buttons should be pill-shaped (rounded-full) for a friendly, organic feel.
Input fields for newsletter should have a distinct border and focus ring (Fresh Lime).
Don't center everything. Use left alignment for body text to improve readability.
